dialogues.en:
They don't really falter now. If things go on like this, I
think only one more day of practice should be enough.
dialogues.text:
They don't really falter now. If things go on like this, I
think only one more day of practice should be enough.

dialogues.jp:
手伝うことがなくなった俺は、窓辺に寄りかか
りながら演奏に耳を傾けていた。
dialogues.en:
The music is very pleasing to my ears, because it's being
played smoother than yesterday.
dialogues.text:
The music is very pleasing to my ears, because it's being
played smoother than yesterday.

dialogues.en:
(If there's no help they need from me, being here isn't so
bad......)
dialogues.text:
(If there's no help they need from me, being here isn't so
bad......)

dialogues.jp:
すでにほとんど、つっかえるところがなくなっ
ていた。この分なら、あと１日練習すれば充分
なのではないだろうか？

昨日に比べ、スムーズに曲が流れていくので、
聴いてて気持ちがいい。
dialogues.en:
When the performance finishes... I'll have to help them with
the cleaning.
dialogues.text:
When the performance finishes... I'll have to help them with
the cleaning.

dialogues.jp:
（これで手伝いさえなければ、悪くなかったん
　だが……）

dialogues.en: What a pain in the neck.
dialogues.text: What a pain in the neck.

dialogues.jp:
音楽部の練習手伝い。特にすることもなく暇だっ
た。
dialogues.en:
With no help they want from me, I'm listening to the
rehearsal and leaning on the window.
dialogues.text:
With no help they want from me, I'm listening to the
rehearsal and leaning on the window.

dialogues.en: The second day of the practice.
dialogues.text: The second day of the practice.
